_note: Transition type definition. Single definition point; scripts/phase_gate.py is
The point of writing the order down is not documentation. It is that a phase
can then be skipped only by editing this file, which is a visible act, rather
than by declaring in prose that the phase happened.

phases.purpose: have the plan checked by an independent basis before any of it is built
prove it, with controls that can fail
confirm it in the place it was delivered to
record what was learned, including what was not achieved

rules.advance: from phase i, the only permitted next phases are i (re-enter) and i+1
rules.enter: the only permitted entry phase is the first one

why_no_skip: Every phase in this list exists because its absence was observed to cause a
specific failure, not because the list looked complete. 'Plan Review' is here
because plans that were only self-reviewed passed and then failed in Build.
The rule that matters is the last one: an unknown phase name is rejected rather
than allowed. A gate that lets through what it does not recognise is a gate
that can be bypassed by inventing a name.
